posts.text: I was asked if I’m going to go to the White House Correspondents' Dinner. Here’s what I said…

Mike Johnson: “A religious leader can say anything they want, but obviously if you wade into political waters, you should expect some political response and I think the Pope has received some of that. Frankly I was taken a bit aback by him saying something about ‘those who engage in war, Jesus doesn’t hear their prayers’ or something. There’s something called the ‘just war’ doctrine.’” via atrupar/X
Trump has once again claimed that gasoline prices will be going down "very soon". Thoughts? via Atrupar / X
JD Vance says stopping funding for Ukraine is one of the proudest things he's done in this administration... Thoughts?
“You’re killing children!” — hecklers shout as VP Vance is interrupted during a TPUSA event X via @acynig
Vance acknowledges voters’ dislike for the current Middle East policy and encourages them to "get more involved and take the country back"... Thoughts? via Acyn / X
Congressman Jamie Raskin is challenging Trump’s cognitive abilities

Mike Johnson: “I talked to the president and told him I don’t think it was being received in the same way he intended it, and he agreed… I don’t think he thought it was sacrilegious at all.” via rpsagainsttrump/X
I feel like I'm living in Groundhog Day…
